{{Quote|This is a bust of the infamous warlord Ugroth. He swore fealty to Darth Nyriss a dozen years ago when she led an Imperial force into his sector to subdue a potential uprising.|Sechel|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Ugroth''' was a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] whose [[Ugroth's sector|sector]] was [[Subjugation of Ugroth's sector|conquered]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="Revan" /> around [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]]<ref name="date">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' indicates that the events depicted in the first part of the novel take place two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the end of the war to [[3956 BBY]], equating the aforementioned section to [[3954 BBY]]. As ''The Old Republic: Revan'' dates the [[Subjugation of Ugroth's sector|subjugation]] of [[Ugroth's sector]] to a dozen years before the first part of the novel, the event must have occurred around [[3966 BBY/Legends|3966 BBY]].</ref> in order to suppress possibilities of rebellion. He swore fealty to [[Darth Nyriss]], a member of the Empire's ruling [[Dark Council]] and the head of the Imperial attackers. In response, Nyriss ordered a commemorative bust of Ugroth, which she placed in her [[Darth Nyriss's stronghold|residence]]. Her attaché, [[Sechel]], later described Ugroth's bust to the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] when he arrived at Nyriss's stronghold.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ugroth was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="Revan" />
